scope.claim: Greedy-argmax causal accuracy only; no cost/cache/serving/heldout claim.
scope.convergence: If round 191 does not strictly shrink the blocking set, pause this proxy branch.

external_pre_round_commitment_replacemen.why: This replaces v5's locally asserted drand floor. It uses the already-authorized GitHub origin as an independent public timestamp and a cryptographically verified drand round; it adds no new repository-specific commitment service.
external_pre_round_commitment_replacemen.manifest_commit: After every v5 freeze item is final, write the exact canonical freeze manifest, commit it as the only content change in a dedicated git commit on glm52-rung0-io-submission, and push that exact commit to git@github.com:bmarti44/frontier-at-home.git. No force push, amend or alternate branch/ref is accepted.
external_pre_round_commitment_replacemen.github_event: Poll the public GitHub REST endpoint /repos/bmarti44/frontier-at-home/events until exactly one PushEvent has repo bmarti44/frontier-at-home, ref refs/heads/glm52-rung0-io-submission, payload.head equal to the manifest commit, and a GitHub-issued RFC3339 created_at. Preserve the exact HTTPS response bytes, response Date header, event id, created_at and SHA-256. Require a successful unauthenticated second fetch with the same id/head/ref/created_at before beacon fetch. A commit date, local mtime, branch head alone or operator-supplied timestamp is invalid.
external_pre_round_commitment_replacemen.exact_round: With default-chain genesis G=1595431050 and period P=30 seconds, parse GitHub created_at as integer Unix seconds T and set R=floor((T-G)/P)+2, the unique first scheduled round strictly after the external event time. Only R is eligible; floor fields and any other past/future round are invalid. The frozen manifest commit hash and GitHub event identity enter the v5 seed domain.
external_pre_round_commitment_replacemen.cryptographic_verification: A pinned, reproducibly built official drand Go client verifier must check the exact chain hash/public key/scheme, BLS signature for R, chaining to the independently fetched and verified R-1 signature, round number and randomness derivation. The three exact relay records must also be byte-equal. HTTPS relay agreement alone cannot pass.
external_pre_round_commitment_replacemen.ordering: The GitHub event's created_at must be strictly before R's scheduled time. Fetch/verify only exact R. If R is unavailable, invalid, missed, or any GitHub/relay record disagrees, this candidate is terminal NO_RESULT; do not select R+1, repush, rebuild, reseed or retry.
mutations: valid historical R with manifest committed/pushed afterward fails because event-derived exact R differs
forged/backdated git commit timestamp fails because only GitHub event created_at is used
branch force-push/ref/head mismatch or missing/duplicate GitHub event fails
R-1, R+1, relay-only equality, wrong chain/key/scheme, broken previous-signature chain or invalid BLS fails
second manifest commit/event after seeing R is a new failed attempt, never a retry

frequency_baseline_dataflow_replacement.replacement: Delete v3/v4 requirements that recurrence replay derives both baselines or that the frequency table is frozen before beacon. Recurrence replay derives only anonymous proxy and gate-replay ranks. It never reads fixture IDs, drand, train-fit rows or frequency output.
frequency_baseline_dataflow_replacement.helper: A distinct clean-reproducible baseline-only helper is frozen in the pre-round manifest. After exact R selects five IDs and before any source/candidate/Phase-B run, it reads only the authenticated selection receipt plus the bound train-fit manifest/records, proves exactly those five IDs are excluded, and counts selected_ids over all rows of the remaining exactly 50 distinct cases.
frequency_baseline_dataflow_replacement.canonical_output: Publish one canonical exact-schema file containing selection-receipt hash, train-fit manifest/records hashes, included 50 IDs, excluded five IDs, and for each exact layer 3..77 all 256 uint64 counts plus expert ranking sorted count descending/expert ID ascending. Unknown/missing/duplicate fields, overflow, wrong layer/expert cardinality, extra rows or trailing bytes FAIL.
frequency_baseline_dataflow_replacement.isolation: The baseline helper exits and its output freezes before candidate source execution. Candidate and recurrence-replay Landlock policies do not admit the helper, selection receipt, train-fit records, canonical frequency output or their parent paths. Only the independent Python scorer reads the frequency output after candidate/Phase-B artifacts freeze.
frequency_baseline_dataflow_replacement.scorer_recompute: The frozen scorer ignores stored ranks for authority, rereads the exact selection and hash-bound train-fit records, independently recomputes the 50-case counts/ranks with uint64 arithmetic and exact ties, requires byte-equality to helper output, then applies the v2 +3pp paired comparison. Gate replay remains independently derived from anonymous z0 by recurrence replay.
mutations: include one selected or non-train-fit row, omit one retained row, duplicate a case, alter count/rank/tie or overflow and fail
make any identity/frequency artifact readable to candidate or recurrence replay and fail sandbox preflight
run helper after source/candidate/Phase-B or let stored ranks bypass scorer recomputation and fail

review_resolution.R05-R190-H1-BLINDED-FREQUENCY-BASELINE-C: A separate post-selection baseline helper/scorer path owns the 50-case prior; anonymous recurrence processes never receive identities or prior data.
review_resolution.ADV-R05-R190-M1-FREQUENCY-BASELINE-AUTHO: The inherited both-baselines clause is explicitly deleted and canonical helper output is independently recomputed by the scorer.
review_resolution.ADV-R05-R190-H1-BEACON-FLOOR-HAS-NO-PRE-: The exact manifest commit must have a matching externally timestamped public GitHub PushEvent; that immutable event time deterministically selects one round, whose BLS signature and chain are verified against frozen default-chain authority. Historical-round grinding cannot change the event-derived R.
